hardware_evidence_vocabulary.NOT_RUN: no hardware capture of this row's cases exists; the default for any row that sets no field
hardware_evidence_vocabulary.CAPTURED: a hardware capture exists but was not acceptance-eligible, so it establishes nothing about PSP behaviour
hardware_evidence_vocabulary.MEASURED: committed, publication-eligible documentation records a real-hardware run of the cases named in evidence_cases; evidence_ref names that document section and evidence_cases must each appear in it verbatim
hardware_evidence_vocabulary.citation_rule: tools/hle_manifest.py grants HARDWARE_MEASURED only from hardware_evidence, and only when MEASURED resolves its evidence_ref through assets/public_source_profile.json and every evidence_case appears in the cited section; status describes the probe source and never grants evidence

tests.measurement_note: The citation covers the three dma-concurrency combinations (concurrent-memcpy-try, concurrent-try-try, concurrent-try-memcpy): 64/64 BUSY from a second-context sceDmacTryMemcpy while the first transfer was pending, and 64/64 zero from a concurrent blocking sceDmacMemcpy, on the qualified PSP-3000-series / 6.61 / ARK-5.1.0 route on 2026-08-27. tests.evidence_note: CASE=hle-ge-edram is built from fixtures/psp_oracle/probe_hle_measure.c and strictly parsed. It ran on the PSP-3000 on 2026-10-10 as a single-case run beside the f6ccfb33 campaign and its stream was complete, but the case was not acceptance-eligible: the runner's post-unload shell qualification and host0 round trip failed on every HLE case. The capture is CAPTURED only and establishes nothing (docs/HARDWARE_ORACLE.md, Measured to date); a MEASURED claim needs an accepted re-run. The capture showed sceGeEdramSetAddrTranslation setting the given width, 0 included, and returning the width it replaced; under that behaviour the probe revision that ran verified its restore with a Set(0), saw 0 on its final read, ended FAIL and left the console at width 0. The probe now verifies and ends with Set(initial), and the parser requires the restored width on both reads.
tests.invariant: eDRAM size and address, and the translation width returned for each documented width; the original width is restored and checked by validate_hle_edram_restore, and a width that cannot be restored skips every width cell
tests.risk: medium; changes the GE translation width and restores it before exit
tests.reset: one PRX launch; the restore is verified before the probe exits; PSPLink soft reset before the next launch
